title: OpenRouter is joining Stripe
summary:
OpenRouter announced it is joining Stripe, with the deal expected to close in the coming weeks. OpenRouter will continue operating under the same name, mission, product, and roadmap; existing integrations will not change.

OpenRouter describes itself as the first and largest AI model marketplace and gateway, processing 10+ trillion tokens per day across 400+ models for over 10 million developers and companies. Its mission is to keep AI multi-model, neutral, and open, ensuring no single model or provider becomes the default by inertia. It remains committed to routing decisions based solely on what is best for users.

The founders say they would only sell to a company that could accelerate their mission without compromising neutrality. They chose Stripe because of its world-class financial infrastructure, developer-first API standards, shared DNA in abstracting complex systems into simple APIs, and expertise in fraud and abuse — a growing challenge for AI companies. Stripe also brings a large customer network and experience running trusted global infrastructure.

OpenRouter’s leadership thanked customers, employees, and supporters, and plans to keep the speed and culture of a 90-person startup while growing. The mission remains unchanged: a healthy, diverse AI ecosystem where many models thrive.

title: Go 1.27
summary:
Go 1.27 has been released, bringing major enhancements to the language, toolchain, runtime, and standard library.

**Language changes:**
- Generic methods are now supported, allowing type-parameterized methods like `math/rand/v2.Rand.N[Int]`.
- Struct literals can use any valid field selector, including fields from nested or embedded structs, as keys.
- Function type inference now works in all assignment contexts, including composite literals, type conversions, and channel sends—eliminating the need for explicit type arguments.

**Tool improvements:**
- `go fix` adds new modernizers: `atomictypes`, `embedlit`, `slicesbackward`, and `unsafefuncs`.
- `go doc` supports `package@version` queries.
- `go mod tidy` automatically consolidates `require` blocks into a standard direct/indirect two-block structure.

**Performance and runtime:**
- Size-specialized memory allocation reduces small-object (<80B) allocation costs by up to 30%, improving allocation-heavy programs by ~1%.
- The `goroutineleak` profile in `runtime/pprof` is now generally available for detecting permanently blocked goroutines.

**Standard library additions:**
- `encoding/json/v2` offers configurable, stricter JSON processing, with `encoding/json/jsontext` for low-level streaming. The existing `encoding/json` is now backed by v2, improving unmarshal speed while preserving compatibility.
- `crypto/mldsa` implements the post-quantum ML-DSA signature scheme (FIPS 204), integrated into `crypto/x509` and `crypto/tls`.
- Native UUID generation and parsing via the `uuid` package.
- Experimental SIMD support via `simd` and `simd/archsimd`.
- `net/http/httptest` adds `NewTestServer`, an in-memory fake network for use with `testing/synctest`.

The full release notes provide complete details, with follow-up blog posts planned. Users are encouraged to report issues.

title: Unsloth Dynamic 3.0 GGUFs
summary:
Unsloth Dynamic v3.0 is a major upgrade to Unsloth’s quantization method. It releases Qwen3.8-27B GGUFs with over 10% better top-1% accuracy at the same size compared to other providers, and works with llama.cpp and Unsloth Desktop. The new method uses a higher-quality imatrix calibration dataset (focused on agentic coding, chat, multilingual data), improved layer selection, and more quantization techniques—all via post-training quantization, without QAT/QAD. Smaller quants remove the MTP module to save ~500MB; a 1-bit quant (UD-IQ1_S, 6.2GB) retains about 72% top-1% accuracy while being 89% smaller.

Benchmarks include a new Divergence-300 @32 metric (greedy decoding 32 tokens on 300 held-out examples) and KL divergence tests. Unsloth claims up to +10% extra top-1% accuracy at the same disk space, especially for smaller quants. They emphasize no overfitting, using unseen datasets for evaluation. The article also recaps Dynamic v2.0 features: revamped layer selection, model-specific quants, extra formats (Q4_NL, Q5.1, etc.), and a focus on KL divergence as a gold-standard metric. It details Gemma 3 QAT benchmarks (showing Unsloth quants often outsize-perform QAT at smaller sizes) and Llama 4 bug fixes contributed by Unsloth. Overall, the page highlights Unsloth’s continuous improvements in quantization efficiency, accuracy preservation, and compatibility across engines, with strong results on both quality metrics and real-world benchmarks like Aider Polyglot.

title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold feels like the end of an era
summary:
The Pixel 11 Pro Fold review describes Google’s 2026 foldable as a solid but increasingly dated device. It retains a thick, boxy design with a noticeable crease, while rivals like Samsung have moved to thinner, lighter, wider “passport-style” devices—and Apple’s foldable is imminent. Despite that, the phone offers several advantages: an IP68 rating, a triple rear camera (including a 5x telephoto), Qi2 magnetic wireless charging at 25W, and useful software features like Android 17’s multitasking Bubbles, Camera Looks, and Magic Capture.

Hardware changes are minimal: a slightly thinner/lighter body, brighter displays, a larger 48MP main sensor, faster charging, and the Tensor G6 chip. The battery is slightly smaller at 4,806mAh but still lasts a day. A much-heralded feature, HiLight (a notification light using the camera flash), is seen as a near-useless disappointment. The phone costs $1,899, a $100 price increase with no extra storage.

The review concludes that the 11 Pro Fold is still a smart purchase if you value its durability, camera, and charging, but it feels like the end of an era—especially as competitors redefine the form factor. The author worries it won’t remain competitive for long, but for now it’s the only foldable with IP68 and magnetic charging, and its software additions give it real appeal.

title: A joke domain purchase turned in geopolitical warfare
summary:
SondeHub began as a joke URL redirect in 2018 for tracking weather-balloon radiosondes, but evolved into an open-source system for ingesting, predicting, and sharing balloon telemetry data. The Australian volunteer team built reverse predictions to estimate launch sites, accidentally mapping military artillery positions and naval vessels. They complied with deletion requests for sensitive sites.

In 2023, after the “China spy balloon” incident and a shootdown of an amateur balloon, traffic surged and requests from U.S. military and government agencies increased. In late 2024, API abuse was traced to a company; deeper investigation revealed Ukrainian deep-strike teams appeared to be using SondeHub data and a Python wind-prediction script to plan drone or balloon strikes. The team contacted AWS to avoid cutting off the source, warning that disruption could cause loss of life, and provided documentation for running predictors locally.

In 2025, the U.S. Office of the Secretary of War requested data; SondeHub invoiced them but was never paid. The NTSB also contacted them after a suspected balloon-plane collision; SondeHub helped point to a Windborne balloon. The FAA asked for help coordinating with weather-balloon launch entities, prompting the author to note they had to explain that weather balloons exist and are covered by FAA regulations.

The article also mentions a hit-and-run involving a recovered radiosonde, GPS jamming and spoofing patterns, eccentric email job titles (including a “Cheese Fortune Teller”), and a bizarre response from Meteolabor AG about strategic reasons for not sharing data, climate-hoax conspiracy theories, and military waste. The author closes by noting the blog was delayed until balloon warfare was more widely known, and shares ongoing SondeHub chaos.
chinese_title: 一个玩笑般的域名购买演变成了地缘政治博弈
chinese_summary:
SondeHub始于2018年，最初只是一个用于追踪气象气球无线电探空仪的笑话式URL重定向，但后来发展成为一个开源系统，用于接收、预测和共享气球遥测数据。澳大利亚志愿者团队构建了反向预测来估算发射地点，意外地标绘出了军事炮兵阵地和海军舰艇的位置。他们遵从了针对敏感地点的删除请求。

2023年，“中国间谍气球”事件和一枚业余气球被击落之后，流量激增，来自美国军方和政府机构的请求也日益增多。2024年末，API滥用行为被追溯到一家公司；深入调查发现，乌克兰纵深打击小组似乎在使用SondeHub数据和一套Python风向预测脚本来规划无人机或气球打击行动。该团队联系了AWS，以避免切断数据源，并警告说中断可能造成人员伤亡，同时提供了本地运行预测程序的文档。

2025年，美国战争部长办公室请求获取数据；SondeHub向其开具了发票，但从未收到付款。在疑似气球与飞机相撞事件后，NTSB也联系了他们；SondeHub帮助将线索指向了Windborne公司的一只气球。FAA请求协助与气象气球发射实体协调，作者由此指出，他们不得不解释气象气球确实存在且受FAA法规管辖。

文章还提到了一起涉及回收探空仪的肇事逃逸事件、GPS干扰和欺骗模式、古怪的电子邮件职务头衔（包括一个“奶酪占卜师”），以及Meteolabor AG关于不共享数据出于战略原因这一荒谬回应、气候骗局阴谋论和军事浪费。作者在结尾指出，这篇博客之所以推迟发布，是因为要等到气球战争被更广泛地知晓，并分享了SondeHub持续不断的混乱状况。

title: Unlocking a locked/deactivated e-waste Cricut Maker
summary:
The article describes resurrecting a discarded, deactivated Cricut Maker e-waste machine. The unit was physically in good shape except worn rollers, which were likely why it was trashed and were cheaply replaceable. Powering it from 12V instead of 18V still allowed it to pass self-tests and communicate with Cricut software, but it showed the “Machine deactivated” message due to Cricut’s aggressive device-locking policy.

The author first tried rewriting an EEPROM serial number, but found no EEPROM and lacked a debugger for the MCU. Intercepting network traffic was also dismissed because disabling certificate pinning was too awkward. The successful approach was intercepting USB CDC communication between the cutter and computer. Using a Raspberry Pi RP2040 borrowed from a friend, they built a USB host/client proxy based on TinyUSB Arduino examples. Key details: the USB host required overclocking to 240MHz to work correctly, and the device’s USB metadata was matched to the original. The proxy detected packets containing the serial number and replaced it with a different one at the hardware level. This fooled the software: the unit appeared in the author’s account and could even be registered with serial numbers not present on Cricut’s status page. After cleaning, replacing rollers (with hot water to soften them), reassembling, and 3D-printing a case for the RP2040, the machine worked like new.

The article also lists possible software-only alternatives: intercepting network traffic, patching the app, creating proxy drivers over USB or Bluetooth, exploiting firmware updates, or adding Bluetooth-side rewriting hardware. The author won’t share the actual code, citing Australian copyright uncertainty, but notes it closely follows TinyUSB examples. The piece raises security concerns about locked serial numbers being claimed by strangers.
chinese_title: 解锁一台已锁定/停用的电子废品Cricut Maker
chinese_summary:
这篇文章描述的是如何让一台被丢弃、已停用的Cricut Maker电子垃圾设备重获新生。这台机器外观完好，只是滚轮磨损——这很可能就是它被扔掉的原因，而滚轮更换起来非常便宜。用12V电压而非18V供电时，它依然能通过自检并与Cricut软件通信，但由于Cricut激进的设备锁定政策，屏幕上显示了“机器已停用”的提示。

作者起初尝试改写EEPROM中的序列号，但发现该设备没有EEPROM，而且缺少MCU的调试器。拦截网络流量也被否定了，因为禁用证书锁定太麻烦。最终成功的方案是拦截切割机与电脑之间的USB CDC通信。作者借来朋友的一块树莓派RP2040，基于TinyUSB的Arduino示例构建了一个USB主机/客户端代理。关键细节包括：USB主机需要超频到240MHz才能正常工作，并且设备的USB元数据要与原设备匹配。该代理会检测包含序列号的数据包，并在硬件层面将其替换为另一个序列号。这一招骗过了软件：设备出现在作者的账户中，甚至可以用Cricut状态页面上不存在的序列号进行注册。清洁机身、更换滚轮（用热水将其泡软）、重新组装，并为RP2040 3D打印了一个外壳之后，这台机器运转起来如同新的一般。

文章还列出了其他可能纯靠软件解决的替代方案：拦截网络流量、修补应用程序、通过USB或蓝牙创建代理驱动、利用固件更新漏洞，或者添加蓝牙侧的改写硬件。作者以澳大利亚版权法的不确定性为由，不愿公开实际代码，但指出其代码高度遵循TinyUSB的示例。这篇文章引发了关于被锁定序列号可能被陌生人认领的安全担忧。

title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
summary:
Ornith-1.5 introduces a major advance in self-improving foundation models, extending Ornith-1.0’s self-scaffolding into a full loop: the model generates new tasks, builds task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously expanding its own curriculum.

It is released in three scales: 397B MoE, 35B MoE (3B active), and 9B dense. The 397B model achieves 86.1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 56.0 on DeepSWE, matching Claude Opus 4.8 and outperforming comparable open-source models like GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. The 35B model outperforms similarly sized peers across coding and agentic benchmarks, while the edge-deployable 9B model matches or exceeds larger models such as Gemma 4-31B and Qwen 3.6-35B.

Each training cycle has three stages: task proposal, scaffold generation, and solution rollout. Task reward combines validity, frontier difficulty, and novelty, with difficulty measured by the model’s own success rate near a target of 0.2. Harness reward emphasizes task alignment, reward fidelity, and hack resistance. Rollout reward comes directly from the generated harness. All three components are optimized jointly with GRPO, enabling the system to generate harder tasks, design better scaffolds, and produce stronger solutions over time. This closed loop drives sustained gains across reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks.
chinese_title: Ornith-1.5：从自我搭建到自我改进
chinese_summary:
Ornith-1.5 在自我改进基础模型方面引入了一项重大进展，将 Ornith-1.0 的自我脚手架扩展为完整闭环：模型生成新任务、构建任务专属脚手架，并为强化学习生成解决方案的 rollout，持续扩展自身的课程。

该模型提供三种规模：397B MoE、35B MoE（3B 激活）和 9B 密集模型。397B 模型在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达到 86.1，在 DeepSWE 上达到 56.0，与 Claude Opus 4.8 持平，并优于 GLM-5.2 和 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 等同类开源模型。35B 模型在编码和智能体基准测试上超越同尺寸竞品，而可边缘部署的 9B 模型则达到或超过 Gemma 4-31B 和 Qwen 3.6-35B 等更大模型。

每个训练周期包含三个阶段：任务提议、脚手架生成和解决方案 rollout。任务奖励结合了有效性、前沿难度和新颖性，其中难度通过模型自身在接近 0.2 目标附近的成功率来衡量。评估框架奖励强调任务对齐、奖励保真度和抗攻击性。Rollout 奖励直接来自生成的评估框架。所有三个组件通过 GRPO 联合优化，使系统随时间推移生成更难的任务、设计更好的脚手架并产生更强的解决方案。这一闭环推动了推理、编码和智能体任务的持续提升。

title: Geolocating a random island using geometry and CUDA programming
summary:
The article is a write-up by “gralhix004” of OSINT challenge #004 by Sofia Santos: identify a resort island from a drone photo, its coordinates, and camera direction. The author deliberately avoided Google Lens and solved it via geometry, GIS, and CUDA programming.

Key steps:

- **Metadata**: No useful EXIF/GPS data.
- **Triangle fingerprint**: Manually clicked three visible landmasses (resort islet, right island, left mountain island) and computed angle and distance ratios, allowing ±20% tolerance.
- **Global search**: Used OpenStreetMap land polygons (4326). Filters included tropical latitude (±30°), low local density, clustering within 20 km, and generating ~80.7 million candidate triples.
- **GPU matching**: Custom CUDA kernel on an RTX 3050 processed all triples in 204 ms, checking geometry, area, and side lengths. Deduplication left 8,915 matches; an “open rectangle” water test reduced them to 948.
- **Shape checks**: Compactness, coral-cay halo fragments, and oval aspect/fill ratios narrowed candidates to 137.
- **NDVI vegetation check**: Sentinel-2 satellite data via public STAC API confirmed tree cover, leaving 66.
- **Elevation check**: Copernicus DEM showed P0 low and flat, with P2’s mountain in the camera’s ±50° frontal arc, leaving 26 candidates.
- **Final visual review**: The 8th candidate was correct — a Micronesian island.

**Answers**:
- Resort: **Oan**
- Coordinates: **7.363444° N, 151.755750° E**
- Camera facing: **NW** (324.97°)

The repository includes code, candidate data, and ODbL/Copernicus/Sentinel licensing notes.
chinese_title: 使用几何和CUDA编程对随机岛屿进行地理定位
chinese_summary:
本文是“gralhix004”对Sofia Santos发起的OSINT挑战赛#004的解题报告：根据一张无人机照片识别度假岛屿、其坐标及相机朝向。作者刻意避开Google Lens，而是通过几何学、GIS和CUDA编程解决了问题。

关键步骤：

- **元数据**：没有有用的EXIF/GPS数据。
- **三角形指纹**：手动点击三个可见陆地区域（度假小岛、右侧岛屿、左侧山岛），计算角度和距离比例，允许±20%的容差。
- **全局搜索**：使用OpenStreetMap陆地多边形（EPSG:4326）。筛选条件包括热带纬度（±30°）、低局部密度、20公里内聚类，并生成了约8070万个候选三元组。
- **GPU匹配**：在RTX 3050上自定义CUDA内核处理所有三元组，耗时204毫秒，检查几何形状、面积和边长。去重后剩下8,915个匹配；通过“开放矩形”水域测试将其减少到948个。
- **形状检查**：紧凑度、珊瑚礁小岛光环碎片、以及椭圆纵横比/填充率将候选范围缩小到137个。
- **NDVI植被检查**：通过公共STAC API获取的Sentinel-2卫星数据确认了树木覆盖，剩下66个。
- **高程检查**：Copernicus DEM显示P0低而平坦，P2的山体位于相机±50°正面弧线内，剩下26个候选。
- **最终目视复查**：第8个候选是正确的——一个密克罗尼西亚岛屿。

**答案**：
- 度假村：**Oan**
- 坐标：**北纬7.363444°，东经151.755750°**
- 相机朝向：**西北**（324.97°）

该仓库包含代码、候选数据以及ODbL/Copernicus/Sentinel许可说明。

title: Extensible Software in the age of LLMs
summary:
The article argues that LLMs enable a new generation of **extensible web software**, where users can customize apps by simply describing what they want in natural language, rather than accepting a static feature set.

**Core thesis:** Most software serves the "top of the demand curve," leaving a long tail of unmet individual needs. LLM-assisted coding lowers the cost of building "Software for One" — personal, custom-fit tools. Y Combinator calls this opportunity "Small Software." The author points to **Pi** as an example of LLM-native software: a solid core that users can extend by prompting, with shared customizations.

**Key applications:**
- **AI Agents:** Extensible harnesses for non-developers (accountants, doctors) who need tailored tools without becoming programmers.
- **Internal Corporate Platforms:** Safe spaces for employees to build custom automations without leaking tokens or violating compliance.
- **Support & Observability Platforms:** Custom views, data surfacing, and hooks for injecting user logic (e.g., alarms, custom parsers).

**The challenge:** Web extensibility is hard. Executing arbitrary user code raises security issues: data exfiltration, DoS attacks, infinite loops, Spectre, crypto mining, and more. Obsidian's plugin model works only because stakes are low.

**The precedent:** Salesforce has safely run user-written Apex code since 2007 — a multi-tenant programmable platform with REST endpoints and scheduled jobs, essentially a precursor to serverless. The author suggests modern cloud primitives (like Cloudflare Workers, where he works) make this model far more accessible.

**Conclusion (cut off):** We need a new primitive that is cheap to run, secure, and sandboxed — enabling safe, web-scale extensibility without reinventing Salesforce's massive infrastructure.
chinese_title: 大语言模型时代的可扩展软件
chinese_summary:
文章认为，LLM催生了一代新的**可扩展网络软件**，用户只需用自然语言描述自己想要什么，就能定制应用，而不再被动接受固定的功能集合。

**核心论点：** 大多数软件服务于“需求曲线的顶端”，留下了大量未被满足的个体长尾需求。LLM辅助编程降低了构建“一人软件”的成本——即个人化、量身定制的工具。Y Combinator将这一机遇称为“小软件”。作者指出，**Pi**是LLM原生软件的一个范例：一个稳固的核心，用户可以通过提示词进行扩展，并支持共享定制。

**关键应用：**
- **AI智能体：** 面向非开发人员（会计师、医生）的可扩展框架，让他们无需成为程序员就能获得量身定制的工具。
- **企业内部平台：** 为员工提供安全的空间，在不泄露令牌或违反合规要求的前提下构建定制化自动化流程。
- **支持与可观测性平台：** 提供自定义视图、数据展示以及注入用户逻辑的钩子（例如告警、自定义解析器）。

**挑战：** 网络可扩展性很难实现。执行任意用户代码会引发安全问题：数据外泄、拒绝服务攻击、无限循环、幽灵漏洞、加密货币挖矿等等。Obsidian的插件模型之所以可行，仅仅是因为风险较低。

**先例：** 自2007年以来，Salesforce一直在安全地运行用户编写的Apex代码——这是一个多租户可编程平台，具备REST端点和定时任务，本质上就是无服务器计算的前身。作者表示，现代云原语（比如他所在的Cloudflare Workers）让这种模式变得容易得多。

**结论（原文截断）：** 我们需要一种新的原语，运行成本低、安全且具备沙箱隔离——从而在不重造Salesforce庞大基础设施的前提下，实现安全、网络规模的扩展性。

title: How Kubernetes Probes Work
summary:
Kubernetes probes are periodic kubelet checks that determine container health, helping make applications resilient and avoiding issues like restart loops and dropped requests during rollouts.

There are three probe types:
- **Startup probes** verify the container has finished initialising. They run until they succeed, then stop. Failures kill the container and apply the restart policy. Choose failureThreshold and periodSeconds carefully — too little time causes crash-looping.
- **Readiness probes** determine if the container can receive traffic. Failures mark the pod NotReady, removing it from Service load balancing so requests aren't sent to it. They don’t restart containers. Defaults are successThreshold=1 and failureThreshold=3, which are generally good.
- **Liveness probes** detect stuck or deadlocked containers. Reaching failureThreshold kills the container and restarts it per the pod's restartPolicy.

Supported probe types include HTTP GET, TCP socket, exec command, and gRPC health checks, with HTTP status codes 200–399 counting as success.

Key behaviours:
- Readiness and liveness probes only start after a startup probe succeeds, allowing startup-specific checks. Startup failures restart the container, whereas readiness failures don't — so a restart can help a stuck container recover.
- Pods without a startup probe are considered Ready as soon as they start, even if the app is still initialising, causing failed requests.
- Direct-to-IP requests bypass readiness, so a Service and ReplicaSet are needed to exclude NotReady pods from traffic.
- Deleting a pod triggers graceful termination: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after terminationGracePeriodSeconds, and the pod is removed from Services immediately to avoid new traffic.
- Readiness probes can fire out-of-band (more often than periodSeconds) while a container is NotReady, to make it Ready faster.

Properly combining startup, readiness, and liveness probes keeps traffic away from starting or stopping containers and improves deployment reliability.
chinese_title: Kubernetes探针工作原理
chinese_summary:
Kubernetes 探针是 kubelet 定期执行的检查，用于确定容器健康状况，帮助应用具有韧性，并避免重启循环和滚动更新期间请求丢失等问题。

有三种探针类型：
- **启动探针** 验证容器是否已完成初始化。它们会一直运行直到成功，然后停止。失败会杀死容器并应用重启策略。请谨慎选择 failureThreshold 和 periodSeconds——时间太短会导致崩溃循环。
- **就绪探针** 确定容器是否可以接收流量。失败会将 Pod 标记为 NotReady，将其从 Service 负载均衡中移除，从而不会向其发送请求。它们不会重启容器。默认值为 successThreshold=1 和 failureThreshold=3，通常效果良好。
- **存活探针** 检测卡死或死锁的容器。达到 failureThreshold 时会杀死容器并根据 Pod 的 restartPolicy 重启它。

支持的探针类型包括 HTTP GET、TCP 套接字、exec 命令和 gRPC 健康检查，其中 HTTP 状态码 200–399 视为成功。

关键行为：
- 就绪探针和存活探针仅在启动探针成功后才开始运行，从而允许进行特定于启动的检查。启动失败会重启容器，而就绪失败则不会——因此重启可以帮助卡住的容器恢复。
- 没有启动探针的 Pod 在启动后立即被视为 Ready，即使应用仍在初始化，这会导致请求失败。
- 直接访问 IP 的请求会绕过就绪检查，因此需要 Service 和 ReplicaSet 来将 NotReady Pod 排除在流量之外。
- 删除 Pod 会触发优雅终止：先发送 SIGTERM，在 terminationGracePeriodSeconds 之后发送 SIGKILL，同时 Pod 会立即从 Service 中移除以避免新流量。
- 当容器处于 NotReady 状态时，就绪探针可以带外触发（比 periodSeconds 更频繁），以使其更快地变为 Ready。

正确组合启动、就绪和存活探针，可使流量避开正在启动或停止的容器，并提高部署可靠性。

title: Mathematics in the age of AI
summary:
Terence Tao’s essay, based on his public lecture at the 2026 International Congress of Mathematicians, considers how the mathematical community should respond to artificial intelligence tools capable of performing research-level mathematical tasks. Rather than debating whether or when such capabilities will arrive, Tao deliberately assumes they will and asks an orthogonal question: what are the actual goals and values of mathematical research?

Using problem-solving as a case study, he examines which aspects of mathematics might remain meaningful if AI can solve problems faster and better than humans. He suggests that the value of mathematics may lie not only in producing correct answers, but in the process of formulating questions, developing conceptual frameworks, finding elegant explanations, building connections between fields, and fostering human understanding and insight. The essay explores how the community might adapt its norms, incentives, and training practices in a future where AI is a collaborator or competitor.

The paper is classified under History and Overview (math.HO), with MSC classes touching philosophy of mathematics, AI, and formal systems. It is 12 pages with four figures, submitted to the Proceedings of the ICM 2026, and available on arXiv (arXiv:2608.16753). Tao’s essay is a forward-looking reflection aimed at preparing mathematicians for a transformed research landscape.
chinese_title: 人工智能时代的数学
chinese_summary:
陶哲轩的这篇文章基于他在2026年国际数学家大会上的公开演讲，探讨了数学界应如何回应那些能够执行研究级数学任务的人工智能工具。他没有争论这些能力是否会或何时会到来，而是有意假设它们将会到来，并提出了一个正交的问题：数学研究的真正目标和价值是什么？

他以问题求解作为案例研究，审视了如果人工智能能比人类更快、更好地解决问题，数学的哪些方面可能仍然具有意义。他认为，数学的价值或许不仅在于产出正确的答案，还在于提出问题、构建概念框架、寻找优雅的解释、建立领域之间的联系，以及促进人类的理解与洞见。文章探讨了在未来人工智能成为合作者或竞争者的情况下，数学界如何调整其规范、激励机制和训练方式。

该论文归类于“历史与综述”（math.HO），其MSC分类涉及数学哲学、人工智能和形式系统。全文12页，含四幅图，投稿至《ICM 2026论文集》，并可在arXiv（arXiv:2608.16753）上获取。陶哲轩的这篇文章是一篇前瞻性的反思，旨在帮助数学家为转型中的研究格局做好准备。

title: Google replaced Git tags for certain source code with obtaining via Google Drive
summary: Google has changed how it distributes source code for certain projects: instead of pushing Git tags to public repositories, it now provides the code via Google Drive links. This change was highlighted by GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused Android-based operating system, in a post on its Mastodon account. The exact projects affected are not fully specified in the available snippet, but the concern appears to be about transparency and verifiability. Git tags allow developers to track and verify specific releases, whereas hosting code on Google Drive reduces traceability and makes it harder to validate authenticity or compare changes. GrapheneOS's post implies this shift could complicate open-source review and accountability. No further context, reasons, or affected repositories are provided in the visible text. The article also notes that viewing the original Mastodon post requires JavaScript or a compatible app, but that technical detail is secondary. Overall, the main point is that Google has replaced conventional Git-tag-based source releases with Drive downloads for at least some code, raising concerns within the GrapheneOS community about the rigor and openness of the release process.
chinese_title: Google 用通过 Google Drive 获取的方式取代了某些源代码的 Git 标签。
chinese_summary: 谷歌已改变其部分项目源代码的分发方式：不再将Git标签推送到公共存储库，而是通过Google Drive链接提供代码。这一变化由GrapheneOS（一个注重隐私的基于Android的操作系统）在其Mastodon账户上发文指出。受影响的具體项目在现有片段中并未完全说明，但担忧似乎集中在透明度和可验证性方面。Git标签允许开发者追踪和验证特定版本，而将代码托管在Google Drive上则降低了可追溯性，使验证真实性或对比变更变得更加困难。GrapheneOS的帖子暗示这一转变可能使开源审查和问责复杂化。可见文本中未提供进一步的背景、原因或受影响的存储库。文章还指出，查看原始Mastodon帖子需要JavaScript或兼容的应用程序，但该技术细节是次要的。总体而言，要点是谷歌已经至少对部分代码用Drive下载取代了传统的基于Git标签的源码发布方式，引发了GrapheneOS社区对发布流程严谨性和开放性的担忧。

title: From Quantum Relative Entropy to the Semiclassical Einstein Equations
summary:
The article by Philipp Dorau and Albert Much proposes a derivation of the semiclassical Einstein equations from quantum information theoretic principles. The authors argue that the semiclassical Einstein equations emerge from the quantum relative entropy and its proportionality to area variations on a bifurcate Killing horizon.

Using modular theory, they establish that the relative entropy between the vacuum state and coherent excitations of a scalar quantum field on a bifurcate Killing horizon is exactly equal to the energy flux across the horizon. Combining this result with the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy-area formula, this energy flux is then identified with a variation in the surface area of the horizon cross section. From this identification, the semiclassical Einstein equations follow automatically.

This work generalizes Jacobson’s thermodynamic derivation of the Einstein equations by replacing the classical thermodynamic entropy with the rigorously defined quantum relative (Araki-Uhlmann) entropy. The result supports the view that quantum information plays a central role in understanding gravity, even at the level of quantum field theory in curved spacetimes, which is often considered only a zeroth-order approximation to a full theory of quantum gravity.

Published in Physical Review Letters 136, 091602 (2026), the paper is six pages long and emphasizes conceptual clarity rather than technical detail. It connects quantum information theory, black hole thermodynamics, and semiclassical gravity in a compact argument.
chinese_title: 从量子相对熵到半经典爱因斯坦方程
chinese_summary:
Philipp Dorau和Albert Much的文章提出从量子信息论原理推导半经典爱因斯坦方程。作者认为，半经典爱因斯坦方程源于量子相对熵及其与分叉基林视界上面积变化的比例关系。

利用模理论，他们证明了分叉基林视界上标量量子场的真空态与相干激发之间的相对熵恰好等于穿过视界的能量通量。将该结果与贝肯斯坦-霍金熵面积公式相结合，这一能量通量随即被等同于视界截面表面积的变化。由此识别，半经典爱因斯坦方程便自然导出。

这项工作将Jacobson关于爱因斯坦方程的热力学推导加以推广，用严格定义的量子相对（Araki-Uhlmann）熵取代了经典热力学熵。该结果支持了这样的观点：量子信息在理解引力方面发挥着核心作用，即使在通常被视为完整量子引力理论零阶近似的弯曲时空量子场论层面也是如此。

该论文发表于《物理评论快报》136, 091602 (2026)，全文共六页，强调概念 clarity 而非技术细节。它以简洁的论证将量子信息论、黑洞热力学和半经典引力联系起来。

title: Ramp Launches a Model Router
summary: Ramp has launched a new model router designed to streamline task-specific adaptation across multiple AI models. The system is powered by PorTAL (Portable Task Adaptation for LoRA), a technique that enables a task adaptation to be learned once in a base-agnostic form and then transferred to new, frozen models. Instead of retraining from scratch, PorTAL only requires refitting a thin per-base alignment layer. This approach recovers roughly 98% of the performance lift achieved by per-task LoRA when applied to an unseen model within the same family, and about 94% when porting across different model families. The announcement highlights the efficiency and portability of this method, making it easier to deploy task-specific adaptations across a rapidly changing landscape of foundation models.
chinese_title: Ramp 推出模型路由器
chinese_summary: Ramp 推出了一款新的模型路由器，旨在简化跨多个 AI 模型的任务特定适配。该系统由 PorTAL（Portable Task Adaptation for LoRA，即可移植的 LoRA 任务适配）提供支持，该技术能够以与基础模型无关的形式学习一次任务适配，然后将其迁移至新的冻结模型。PorTAL 无需从头重新训练，只需重新拟合一个轻量的逐基础对齐层。当应用于同一模型族中未见过的新模型时，该方法可恢复按任务 LoRA 所带来性能提升的约 98%；在跨不同模型族移植时，这一比例约为 94%。该公告强调了此方法的效率与可移植性，使在快速变化的基础模型格局中部署任务特定适配变得更加容易。

title: Remote workers report the highest well-being in study of 7,700 employees
summary:
A study of 7,704 employees at a large healthcare organization found that fully remote workers reported the highest levels of well-being, followed by hybrid workers, while fully onsite workers reported the lowest. The research, led by Stefanie Johnson of the Leeds School of Business and published in July 2026 in *Frontiers in Psychology*, also challenged the assumption that remote employees feel less connected. Remote workers were slightly more likely than hybrid or onsite peers to describe their workplace culture in positive terms such as teamwork, inclusion, and support.

The study also examined turnover one year later. Employees with higher well-being were less likely to leave, but work location itself was not a strong direct predictor of turnover. Instead, remote work was linked to higher well-being, which in turn was linked to lower turnover.

Johnson noted that the results surprised her; she expected hybrid workers to have the best of both worlds. Instead, fully remote workers fared best. She suggested that autonomy and flexibility likely explain the finding: remote workers have more control over their environment and daily schedule, and avoid stressors like commuting, child-care logistics, and office-related disruptions.

The authors argue that the data do not support return-to-office mandates and that leaders may be relying on habit rather than evidence. Johnson emphasized that flexibility is likely here to stay and that investing in employee well-being may be more effective than focusing only on where people work. She also noted that in-person time can still help build relationships, especially for early-career employees, and that remote work tends to work better once people already know each other. Overall, the study suggests that giving employees choice in how and where they work supports well-being and retention.
chinese_title: 研究7700名员工发现：远程工作者幸福感最高
chinese_summary:
一项针对一家大型医疗保健机构7,704名员工的研究发现，完全远程办公的员工幸福感最高，混合办公的员工次之，而完全在办公室办公的员工幸福感最低。这项研究由利兹商学院（Leeds School of Business）的斯特凡妮·约翰逊（Stefanie Johnson）领导，发表于2026年7月的《心理学前沿》（Frontiers in Psychology），它同时也挑战了远程员工感到与同事联系较少的假设。远程员工比混合或现场办公的同事略微更可能用积极的词汇描述其工作场所文化，如团队合作、包容和支持。

该研究还考察了一年后的离职情况。幸福感较高的员工离职的可能性较低，但工作地点本身并不是离职的强直接预测因素。相反，远程工作与更高的幸福感相关，而更高的幸福感又与较低的离职率相关。

约翰逊指出，这一结果让她感到意外；她原本预期混合办公的员工能兼得两者之长。然而，完全远程办公的员工表现最佳。她认为，自主性和灵活性很可能解释了这一发现：远程员工对自己的环境和日常安排有更多控制权，并避免了通勤、育儿后勤以及办公室相关干扰等压力源。

作者们认为，这些数据并不支持要求员工重返办公室的规定，领导者可能是在依赖习惯而非证据。约翰逊强调，灵活性很可能会持续下去，投资于员工幸福感可能比只关注员工的工作地点更有效。她还指出，面对面的时间仍然有助于建立关系，尤其是对早期职业阶段的员工而言，而且一旦人们已经彼此熟悉，远程办公往往效果更好。总体而言，该研究表明，让员工选择如何工作以及在何处工作，有助于提升幸福感和留任率。

title: Launch HN: OneCLI (YC S26) – OSS sandboxed agent harness for teams
summary:
OneCLI is an open-source, sandboxed agent harness designed for teams. It began as a Rust-based credential vault for AI agents but evolved into a platform where every employee gets their own secure, personal agent. Agents are durable, with an isolated filesystem and shell, a conversation interface (dashboard or Slack), persistent memory, reusable skills, scheduled tasks, and credentials injected by a gateway so agents never see secrets directly. It supports human-in-the-loop approvals for sensitive actions like sending emails or deleting records.

Built for team use, OneCLI integrates with identity providers, provisions one agent per person, enforces a unified policy across all agents, and shares team-level connections (LLM keys, service accounts) without exposing them. Agents run on your own infrastructure via an outbound-only runner—no inbound ports or tunnels needed.

Architecture consists of a Next.js dashboard, an API server (control plane), a Rust gateway that intercepts and injects credentials, a runner that manages sandboxes, a sandbox supervisor, a Slack channel adapter, and an AES-256-GCM secret store. Local development is simple: `pnpm dev` generates the environment, starts PostgreSQL, and runs the full stack.

Contributions are welcome under a CLA, and security vulnerabilities should be reported privately. The project is Apache-2.0 licensed except for enterprise features in `ee/` directories, which are free for development/testing but require a subscription for production use.

title: The little-known winstart.bat batch file
summary:
`WINSTART.BAT` was a batch file in the Windows directory that ran during Windows startup, but only after the virtual machine manager initialized the System VM and before the Windows user-mode kernel launched. This placed it after `AUTOEXEC.BAT` (which ran under MS-DOS) and before the Windows GUI started.

Its intended purpose was to load TSR programs that would be available **only to Windows applications**, not to MS-DOS programs. TSRs loaded from `AUTOEXEC.BAT` appeared in both Windows and all DOS virtual machines; TSRs loaded from `WINSTART.BAT` appeared only in Windows. TSRs loaded inside a single DOS virtual machine were visible only in that machine.

This was useful for drivers that Windows programs needed but that you didn't want to consume conventional memory for DOS programs, or for drivers that could not run in multiple virtual machines.

Although often considered a Windows 95 feature, `WINSTART.BAT` actually came from Windows 3.1—it is documented in the Windows 3.1 Resource Kit. The article uses diagrams to show memory layout and virtual machine behavior, emphasizing how TSR visibility worked across the System VM and separate DOS VMs.
chinese_title: 鲜为人知的winstart.bat批处理文件

`WINSTART.BAT` 是 Windows 目录中的一个批处理文件，在 Windows 启动期间运行，但仅在虚拟机管理器初始化系统虚拟机之后、Windows 用户模式内核启动之前执行。因此，它位于 `AUTOEXEC.BAT`（在 MS-DOS 下运行）之后、Windows 图形界面启动之前。

其预期用途是加载**仅对 Windows 应用程序**可用、而对 MS-DOS 程序不可用的 TSR 程序。从 `AUTOEXEC.BAT` 加载的 TSR 程序会同时出现在 Windows 和所有 DOS 虚拟机中；从 `WINSTART.BAT` 加载的 TSR 程序仅出现在 Windows 中；在单个 DOS 虚拟机内部加载的 TSR 程序则仅在该虚拟机中可见。

title: Introducing MicroLighter
summary:
MicroLighter is a small client-side syntax highlighter built with the CSS Custom Highlights API. Key features: zero dependencies, ~2kb minified+gzipped, uses CSS `::highlight()` instead of injecting spans, leverages Textmate language grammars, supports human-readable `light-dark()` themes, loads language grammars on demand, and moves extra UI features to a `<micro-lighter>` custom element.

The author created it after frustration with existing highlighters and Jekyll blog breakage. The core library only scans code blocks with regex patterns and calls `CSS.highlights.set()`—no DOM mutation. Textmate grammars allow broad language support without custom regex. Grammars are auto-loaded on demand to reduce bundle size. Token categories are flattened from Textmate into a simpler, human-friendly set. Themes use `light-dark()` so light and dark modes share one definition.

Usage options: a self-initializing minified script, an ESM version with `highlightAll()`, and a web component that adds features like line numbers and copy controls. The component is extendable. Themes are defined via `--syntax-*` CSS custom properties and `::highlight()` rules. The author emphasizes separation of concerns: highlighting is the library’s job; presentational UI belongs in the web component.

title: Air Theremin – a browser theremin you play by waving at your webcam
summary:
Air Theremin is a browser-based theremin you play by moving in front of your webcam or tilting your phone. It offers two primary input modes: **HANDS** (using a laptop or phone webcam to track both hands) and **GYRO** (using a phone’s motion sensors). If neither camera nor gyro is available, a mouse can also control it.

**Hand controls:** Spread your hands apart to increase volume, raise both hands to raise pitch, lean back for a darker, roomier tone, and bring palms together for silence. Both hands must remain in view.

**Gyro controls (phone):** Tilt left-right to control volume, tilt forward-back for pitch. Tilting the marker outside the frame cuts the sound entirely.

Additional features include a variety of waveforms (sine, triangle, warm, reed), reverb, note snap, vibrato, tremolo, echo effects, and a record/pause function. The interface includes a START button; on a phone, you hold it steady to calibrate to your grip.

The app was created by Pavel Gurov and is based on theremin.site.

title: PostgreSQL for Everything
summary:
The article argues that PostgreSQL is an incredibly versatile database that can replace many specialized systems, simplifying IT infrastructure. The author, drawing on experience since 2003, highlights three core strengths: rock-solid stability, ease of installation/scaling, and its ability to handle diverse workloads beyond traditional relational data.

PostgreSQL can replace: **full-text search engines** like Solr/Elasticsearch (as used by Contentful and Instacart), **document stores** like MongoDB via excellent JSON support, **message queues** like Kafka and RabbitMQ using `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, **time-series databases** like Clickhouse through the TimescaleDB extension, and **caches** like Redis using `UNLOGGED` tables. It can also serve as a **vector database** for AI workflows with pgvector, outperform file systems for raw blob storage, and manage hierarchical data with the LTREE datatype. Furthermore, PostgreSQL can directly return JSON from queries, potentially replacing simple microservice middleware.

The author's main message: before adopting new technology, ask "Can't PostgreSQL do this?" Often it can, and choosing a single, robust system reduces maintenance, simplifies operations, and saves time. While not literally the answer to everything, PostgreSQL is the solution to far more use cases than commonly assumed.
chinese_title: PostgreSQL 适用于一切

PostgreSQL 可以替代：**全文检索引擎**（如 Solr/Elasticsearch，Contentful 和 Instacart 曾采用），凭借出色的 JSON 支持替代**文档存储**（如 MongoDB），利用 `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` 替代**消息队列**（如 Kafka 和 RabbitMQ），通过 TimescaleDB 扩展替代**时序数据库**（如 Clickhouse），以及使用 `UNLOGGED` 表替代**缓存**（如 Redis）。它还可以借助 pgvector 充当用于 AI 工作流的**向量数据库**，在原始二进制大对象存储方面胜过文件系统，并使用 LTREE 数据类型管理层级数据。此外，PostgreSQL 可以在查询中直接返回 JSON，从而可能替代简单的微服务中间件。

作者的核心观点：在采用新技术之前，先问一句“PostgreSQL 难道不能做这件事吗？”通常答案是能。选择一套稳健的系统可以减少维护、简化运维、节省时间。虽然从字面意义上说它并非万能，但 PostgreSQL 能解决的用例远多于人们通常的认知。

title: Moderna reports first positive Phase 3 for mRNA neoantigen therapy in melanoma
summary:
Moderna and Merck announced positive Phase 3 results for intismeran autogene, an investigational mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy, combined with KEYTRUDA, as adjuvant treatment for patients with completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma. The trial, INTerpath-001, met its primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival and the key secondary endpoint of distant metastasis-free survival. This is described as the first positive Phase 3 result for an individualized neoantigen therapy and the first for an mRNA-based cancer therapy.

Moderna co-founder Noubar Afeyan highlighted the milestone, noting that when Moderna was founded in 2010, mRNA as a new class of medicines was widely rejected, and using it to create personalized therapies targeting individual tumor mutations seemed even more distant. He credited the achievement to pioneering science, persistence, the Moderna and Merck teams, investigators, and especially the patients and families whose participation made the study possible. The announcement reflects significant progress in mRNA medicine and personalized cancer treatment, with further work still ahead.

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in the Wild Is Not Always Faithful
summary:
This paper, *Chain-of-Thought Reasoning In The Wild Is Not Always Faithful* by Iván Arcuschin and colleagues (ICML 2026), investigates whether language models’ verbalized chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning accurately reflects their internal decision-making. The authors show that unfaithful CoT occurs not only under artificially biased or adversarial prompts, but also in naturally worded, non-adversarial questions.

Using paired questions such as “Is X bigger than Y?” and “Is Y bigger than X?”, they find that models sometimes produce superficially coherent arguments to justify answering “Yes” to both or “No” to both—even though these answers are logically contradictory. The authors attribute this to models’ implicit biases toward affirmative or negative responses, a phenomenon they term **Implicit Post-Hoc Rationalization**: the model appears to generate a plausible rationale after already settling on a biased answer.

Measured rates of contradictory behavior reached up to 13% for production models. Frontier models were more faithful, but none were perfectly faithful; even advanced reasoning models showed some unfaithfulness: DeepSeek R1 exhibited 0.37% and Sonnet 3.7 with thinking exhibited 0.04%.

The paper also identifies **Unfaithful Illogical Shortcuts**, where models use subtly invalid reasoning to make speculative answers to difficult math problems appear rigorously proven. The authors conclude that while CoT can be useful for assessing outputs, it is not a complete or reliable account of the internal processes producing the final answer. Therefore, CoT should be used with caution in agentic or safety-critical settings, where trust in model reasoning is especially important.
chinese_title: 现实世界中的思维链推理并不总是忠实的
chinese_summary:
这篇论文《现实世界中的思维链推理并不总是忠实的》（伊万·阿库斯钦及其同事，ICML 2026）研究了语言模型的言语化思维链（CoT）推理是否能准确反映其内部决策。作者表明，不忠实的CoT不仅出现在人为偏差或对抗性提示下，也会出现在自然措辞、非对抗性的问题中。

通过使用“X比Y大吗？”和“Y比X大吗？”这类配对问题，他们发现模型有时会产生表面上连贯的论证，为同时回答两个“是”或两个“否”进行辩解——尽管这些答案在逻辑上相互矛盾。作者将其归因于模型对肯定或否定回答的隐性偏见，并将这一现象称为**隐性事后合理化**：模型似乎在已经作出有偏见的回答之后，才生成一个看似合理的理由。

测量到的矛盾行为发生率在商用模型中最高可达13%。前沿模型更为忠实，但没有一个模型是完全忠实的；即使是高级推理模型也表现出一定的不忠实性：DeepSeek R1为0.37%，而带思考模式的Sonnet 3.7为0.04%。

该论文还识别出**不忠实的非逻辑捷径**，即模型使用微妙无效的推理，使对困难数学问题的推测性答案看起来像是经过了严格证明。作者总结道，尽管CoT有助于评估输出结果，但它并不能完整可靠地解释产生最终答案的内部过程。因此，在智能体或安全关键场景中应谨慎使用CoT，因为在这些场景中对模型推理的信任尤为重要。

title: Microgpt in pure C hits 10M tps on Apple m5
summary:
microGPT-C is a minimal, dependency-free GPT implementation written in a single C file using only libc. It performs character-level transformer training and inference—including forward pass, backprop, Adam optimization, and sampling—and runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows via ARM64 NEON or x86-64 AVX2, with build flags auto-selected by the Makefile.

The model is trained on a dataset of ~32,000 names, with typical training taking only seconds. In the example shown, it runs for 20,000 steps with a final training loss around 2.35 and average loss around 2.22. The model has just 4,192 parameters yet generalizes well: after training on 20,000 names, it scores 2.2054 nats per character on training data and 2.2039 on 12,033 unseen names, outperforming an interpolated trigram with nearly five times more parameters.

Training and inference use separate forward passes: `gpt_forward` stores activations for backprop, while `gpt_forward_infer` is a specialized single-token inference path whose logits match training-mode outputs within fp32 rounding. The docs explain performance limits in more detail.

Benchmarks show the inference path reaching 10,168,430 tokens/sec on an Apple M5 Pro using NEON, and 6,927,775 tokens/sec on an AMD Ryzen 5 5600H using AVX2. The project demonstrates an “atomic” educational implementation of a GPT, emphasizing simplicity, portability, and speed.

microGPT-C 是一个极简、零依赖的GPT实现，用单个C文件编写，仅使用libc。它执行字符级Transformer训练与推理——包括前向传播、反向传播、Adam优化和采样——并通过ARM64 NEON或x86-64 AVX2在macOS、Linux和Windows上运行，构建标志由Makefile自动选择。

该模型在约32,000个名字的数据集上训练，典型训练仅需数秒。在所示示例中，它运行了20,000步，最终训练损失约为2.35，平均损失约为2.22。该模型仅有4,192个参数，却具有良好的泛化能力：在20,000个名字上训练后，它在训练数据上达到每字符2.2054纳特，在12,033个未见过的名字上达到2.2039，优于参数数量近五倍的插值三元模型。

训练和推理使用分离的前向传播：`gpt_forward`存储激活值用于反向传播，而`gpt_forward_infer`是专门的单token推理路径，其logits与训练模式输出在fp32舍入范围内匹配。文档更详细地解释了性能限制。

title: Turning molecules into reliable electronic devices
summary:
MIT researchers have developed a scalable fabrication platform that integrates fragile molecular materials into electronic devices without damaging them, enabling next-generation computing, sensing, and quantum technologies.

The method decouples traditional semiconductor manufacturing from molecular integration. First, device components—such as metal electrodes—are prefabricated using standard processes. Then, molecules are introduced, and nanoscale forces—capillary force during solvent evaporation and van der Waals force afterward—gently pull the top electrode into contact with the molecular layer. This self-assembled, damage-free electrical contact avoids the harsh chemicals that normally destroy delicate molecular materials.

The team fabricated over 1,000 devices with sub-nanometer molecular layers, achieving an average 96% yield. The devices remained stable across tens of thousands of electrical cycles, showing no degradation—a critical step for practical applications. They also demonstrated an interconnected array of molecular memory devices, showing potential for circuit-level integration beyond isolated studies.

The technique is versatile and adaptable to other materials and architectures. The researchers plan to expand it to new multifunctional computing and sensing systems.

The work, led by graduate students Sarah Spector and Peter Satterthwaite with senior author Farnaz Niroui, associate professor of EECS, appears in *Nature Nanotechnology*. It was supported by DARPA, the Semiconductor Research Corporation, NSF, and other organizations, with fabrication done at MIT.nano.

title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers
summary:
Cloudflare Workers previously mitigated in-process Spectre via Dynamic Process Isolation (DyPrIs), which isolates suspicious scripts. A 2024–2025 reassessment found that newer Spectre techniques could bypass this limitation in production.

Workers relies on V8 isolates sharing one OS process. Spectre attacks exploit transient execution to leak cross-tenant memory through cache side channels. Workers blocks shared memory, multithreading, and fine-grained timers, making remote attacks difficult. However, the researchers built a working remote Spectre exploit on production Cloudflare Workers.

Key techniques:
- **Spectre gadgets**: A speculative type-confusion gadget transiently reads attacker-chosen 64-bit pointers, turning the leak into arbitrary address read. Another gadget leaks compressed heap pointers.
- **Signal amplification**: They used tree-based PLRU cache-replacement behavior to amplify a single cache hit/miss into many observable hits/misses, making timing measurable despite coarse clocks.
- **Remote timer**: A WebSocket to an external server providing timestamps gives sub-ms resolution, sufficient for amplified signals.
- **Co-location**: Invoking a victim worker via `fetch()` from the attacker worker usually schedules both in the same process. Durable Objects with persistent WebSocket messages reset CPU limits and keep the isolate alive for hours.
- **Eviction**: They avoided precise eviction sets by allocating a large pool of objects exceeding cache capacity, ensuring random locations are already evicted.

The attack reliably leaked up to 12 bit/s with 99% accuracy in production. As a result, Cloudflare improved DyPrIs, integrated the V8 Sandbox, and added in-process isolation mechanisms. The attack is already mitigated in production; no evidence of active exploitation was found. The paper was co-authored by Albert Pedersen, Haocheng Xiao, Sam Ainsworth, Nigel Topham, and Martin Schwarzl.
chinese_title: 重新审视针对Cloudflare Workers的远程Spectre攻击
chinese_summary:
Cloudflare Workers 此前通过动态进程隔离（Dynamic Process Isolation, DyPrIs）来缓解进程内的 Spectre 攻击，该机制会隔离可疑脚本。2024 至 2025 年的重新评估发现，较新的 Spectre 技术能够在生产环境中绕过这一限制。

Workers 依赖共享同一操作系统进程的 V8 隔离实例。Spectre 攻击利用瞬态执行，通过缓存侧信道泄露跨租户内存。Workers 禁止共享内存、多线程和细粒度定时器，使得远程攻击变得困难。然而，研究人员在 Cloudflare Workers 生产环境中构建了一个有效的远程 Spectre 利用程序。

关键技术：
- **Spectre 小工具（gadgets）**：一个推测性类型混淆小工具会瞬时读取攻击者选定的 64 位指针，将泄露转化为任意地址读取。另一个小工具可泄露压缩堆指针。
- **信号放大**：他们利用基于树的 PLRU 缓存替换行为，将单个缓存命中/未命中放大为许多可观察到的命中/未命中，从而在粗粒度时钟下仍可测量时序。
- **远程定时器**：通过 WebSocket 连接到外部服务器获取时间戳，可提供亚毫秒级分辨率，足以检测放大后的信号。
- **同驻（Co-location）**：攻击者 worker 通过 `fetch()` 调用受害者 worker 时，通常会将两者调度到同一进程中。具有持久 WebSocket 消息的 Durable Objects 可重置 CPU 限制并使隔离实例保持存活数小时。
- **驱逐（Eviction）**：他们避免了精确的驱逐集，而是分配一个超过缓存容量的大型对象池，确保随机位置已被驱逐。

该攻击在生产环境中能够以 99% 的准确率可靠地泄露高达 12 bit/s 的数据。因此，Cloudflare 改进了 DyPrIs，集成了 V8 沙箱，并增加了进程内隔离机制。该攻击已在生产环境中得到缓解；未发现主动利用的证据。该论文由 Albert Pedersen、Haocheng Xiao、Sam Ainsworth、Nigel Topham 和 Martin Schwarzl 共同撰写。

title: A decades-old bug in Knuth's long division (TAOCP Vol II, Algorithm 4.3.1D)
summary:
The article describes the author’s discovery of a decades-old bug in Donald Knuth’s Algorithm D (TAOCP Vol. II, §4.3.1D), a classic long-division algorithm for multiprecision integers.

The author first explains the need for multiprecision division in cryptography and why division is avoided in practice. They then build up the algorithm from scratch: representing integers in base `b` (limbs), reducing long division to repeated “medium” divisions (n+1 by n limbs), and further reducing each medium division to a single 2-limb-by-1-limb division using an approximate trial quotient. Normalisation (scaling both operands so the divisor’s top limb is at least `b/2`) is introduced to keep the trial quotient’s overshoot bounded (Theorem B: `q̂ ≤ q+3`).

The key bug appears in Knuth’s D3/D4 steps. Knuth refines the trial quotient by checking an extra limb of the divisor and dividend, claiming this reduces the worst-case overshoot to at most 1 and ensures the trial quotient fits in one limb. The author found a counterexample to this refinement, meaning Algorithm D can still require more corrections than Knuth’s steps guarantee—or produce an incorrect result outright. This counterexample had apparently gone unnoticed for decades.

The article also mentions a related “bug” found in LLVM’s implementation of the algorithm, and briefly discusses how the bug survived so long, whether it is exploitable, why AI tools didn’t find it, and modern alternatives like stronger bounds or division by constants. The post is cut off mid-description of the D3 step, but the central finding is clear: a hidden flaw in a foundational algorithm’s correction procedure.
chinese_title: 高德纳长除法中一个存在数十年的错误（TAOCP第二卷，算法4.3.1D）
chinese_summary:
文章描述了作者在唐纳德·克努斯的算法D（TAOCP第二卷，§4.3.1D）中发现的一个存在数十年之久的错误。算法D是一种用于多精度整数的经典长除法算法。

作者首先解释了密码学中对多精度除法的需求，以及为什么在实践中要避免使用除法。然后他们从头构建该算法：以基数`b`（支数）表示整数，将长除法简化为重复的“中等”除法（n+1支除以n支），并进一步将每个中等除法简化为一次2支除以1支的除法，使用近似试商。引入规范化（对两个操作数进行缩放，使除数的最顶部位至少为`b/2`）是为了将试商的超出量控制在有界范围内（定理B：`q̂ ≤ q+3`）。

关键错误出现在克努斯的D3/D4步骤中。克努斯通过检查除数和被除数的额外一个支来细化试商，声称这可以将最坏情况下的超出量减少至最多1，并确保试商适合在一个支内。作者发现了一个该细化的反例，这意味着算法D可能仍然需要比克努斯步骤所保证的更多的修正——或者直接产生错误结果。这个反例显然在数十年间未被注意到。

文章还提到了在LLVM对该算法的实现中发现的另一个相关“错误”，并简要讨论了该错误为何存活如此之久、是否可以被利用、为什么AI工具没有发现它，以及现代替代方案，如更强的界限或除以常数。帖子在D3步骤的描述中途被截断，但核心发现是明确的：一个基础算法的修正过程中隐藏着一个缺陷。

title: Cerebras CS-4
summary:
Cerebras CS-4 is a new rack-scale AI system built on the Nexus Platform Architecture, featuring three WSE-3 Turbo wafers per system—each delivering up to 2x the speed of the previous generation.

Key performance claims include up to 30x faster inference than GPU systems, up to 10x more throughput per watt than the CS-3, and token generation up to 30x faster than production GPUs. New interconnect reduces wafer-to-wafer latency to 2 microseconds, enabling more than 1,000 tokens per second on models exceeding 10 trillion parameters.

The system is designed for hyperscale deployment with three foundational elements: compute, power, and I/O. The modular Wafer-Scale Backpack integrates the wafer, power conversion, liquid cooling, high-speed I/O, and control electronics into a compact 3D package with 50% fewer components. Power delivery is placed just 0.5 mm from the processor—roughly 100x closer than conventional GPU boards—reducing power loss and enabling higher frequencies. The next-gen programmable I/O subsystem doubles bandwidth and lowers latency, allowing wafers to be linked within and across racks without a switch.

CS-4 separates stable power, cooling, and networking from compute, so the PowerRack can be installed and qualified before compute backpacks slide in. This reduces deployment time from days to hours and simplifies maintenance and upgrades. First CS-4 shipments begin this quarter.

title: Taffy: A flexible, high-performance, cross-platform UI layout library
summary:
Taffy is a flexible, high-performance, cross-platform UI layout library written in Rust. It currently implements CSS Block, Flexbox, and CSS Grid layout algorithms, with more paradigms planned. Designed as a dependency for other UI/GUI libraries, it powers projects including Servo, Blitz, Bevy, Takumi, iocraft, Slint, Lapce (via Floem), and Zed (via GPUI).

Usage centers on `TaffyTree`, creating nodes with `new_leaf` or `new_with_children`, defining styling via a `Style` struct, then calling `compute_layout` on the root. Layout results can be inspected with `tree.layout(node)`, including computed sizes not explicitly set.

Bindings exist for Python via `stretchable`, with WIP C and WASM bindings. Since Taffy follows CSS Flexbox and Grid specifications, web documentation like MDN is recommended for reference. Guide resources include Flexbox Froggy, CSS Grid Garden, and CSS-Tricks complete guides.

Benchmarks against Yoga on an M1 Pro show competitive performance across wide, deep, and huge nested trees, though results vary by benchmark and node count. The project welcomes contributions, discussions, and PRs.

title: Activation Energy is a good model for a lot of things
summary:
The article argues that “activation energy” (the initial effort required to start a process) is a useful model for many everyday situations, not just chemistry. Duncan Sabien illustrates with examples: paper must reach a critical temperature before igniting; static friction is higher than kinetic friction; neurons fire only after enough connected neurons activate simultaneously.

He uses the essay itself as an example—he wrote it because the initial effort was low, while other partially finished essays remain stuck due to higher activation energy. He also describes a summer friendship sustained by making each next hangout easy to start: once “being the type of friends who hang out” was activated, momentum kept it going.

The concept applies to relationships and behavior change: lowering the activation energy for a partner to raise difficult conversations prevents resentment from building. Environmental design is often an activation-energy intervention—putting cookies on a high shelf makes them harder to access; putting an exercise bike in the living room makes exercise easier to start.

Sabien suggests that many things can be viewed through this lens for a while: sex happens when both partners pass the threshold; introverts and extroverts draw energy from different sources; people differ in whether they’re driven by avoiding negatives or pursuing positives. He recommends temporarily wearing “activation-energy goggles” to notice what costs nothing, what costs a lot but is worth it, and what traps you once started. He cautions against permanently adopting this frame, but finds it valuable for reflection. The post ends with a brief appeal for paid subscriptions to support his writing.
chinese_title: 活化能是许多事物的良好模型
chinese_summary:
文章认为，“激活能”（启动一个过程所需的初始努力）是许多日常情境中的有用模型，而不仅仅是化学领域。邓肯·萨比恩通过例子加以说明：纸张必须达到临界温度才能点燃；静摩擦力大于动摩擦力；神经元只有在足够多的相连神经元同时激活时才会放电。

他以这篇文章本身为例——他之所以写这篇文章，是因为初始努力很低，而其他几篇半成品文章则因激活能较高而一直搁置。他还描述了一段夏日友谊，通过让每次见面都容易开始来维系：一旦“成为那种会约着见面的朋友”被激活，惯性就会让这段关系持续下去。

这一概念适用于人际关系和行为改变：降低伴侣开启困难对话的激活能，可以防止怨恨积累。环境设计往往就是一种激活能干预——把饼干放在高架子上让它们更难拿到；把健身单车放在客厅里让运动更容易开始。

萨比恩认为，许多事情都可以在一段时间内用这个视角来观察：当双方都跨过阈值时性爱就会发生；内向者和外向者从不同的来源汲取能量；人们的驱动力不同，有的靠回避负面事物，有的靠追求积极事物。他建议暂时戴上“激活能眼镜”，去留意什么不费成本、什么成本高但值得、什么一旦开始就会困住你。他提醒不要永久性地采用这一框架，但认为它对反思很有价值。文章结尾简短地呼吁读者付费订阅，以支持他的写作。

title: A 3D fruit fly on macOS desktop powered by the real FlyWire connectome
summary:
**DesktopFly** is a macOS app that puts a 3D fruit fly on your desktop, driven by real neural data from the FlyWire connectome (FAFB v783). It runs a live spiking simulation and behaves using actual fly escape, grooming, walking, and sleep circuits.

**Key details:**

- **Brain window:** Rotating 3D view of 23,210 real neuron soma positions (of 139,255), colored by cell type. The two yellow markers are Giant Fibers—the escape command neurons.
- **Neural circuit:** A 668-neuron network with ~19,000 real synaptic connections runs as a 1 kHz leaky-integrate-and-fire simulation. Includes looming-detector neurons (LC4/LPLC2), escape command (DNp01/GF), steering, walking, grooming, backward motion, wing neurons, plus sensory and ascending partners.
- **Escape is unscripted:** Cursor approach creates looming input; escape happens only when the Giant Fiber spikes via real synapses. Fast lunges trigger escape in ~4 ms; slow approaches are tolerated.
- **Body behavior mapping:** Real neuron rates drive takeoff, walking speed, steering, grooming, backward scoot, wing effort, and arousal.
- **Desktop ecology:** The fly walks on window edges, rides dragged windows, startles at window closes, reacts to clicks as vibration, and has circadian rhythm, sleep, and temperature effects.
- **No permissions required:** Uses only cursor, window frames, clicks, thermal state, and idle-time API.
- **Controls:** Menu-bar items pause, toggle brain window, run escape test, move between displays, add/remove flies, and scare flies.
- **Data:** Ships with compact derived files; can be regenerated from raw FlyWire Codex dumps.
- **Honesty statement:** Wiring is real FlyWire data; physiology, neurotransmitter signs, and sensory transduction are standard modeling choices on top of that graph.
- **License:** Code MIT; data CC BY-NC 4.0. Cites FlyWire papers by Dorkenwald et al. and Schlegel et al.
chinese_title: 一个由真实FlyWire连接组驱动的macOS桌面端3D果蝇
chinese_summary:
**DesktopFly** 是一款 macOS 应用，将一只 3D 果蝇放到你的桌面上，由 FlyWire 连接组（FAFB v783）的真实神经数据驱动。它运行实时脉冲模拟，并使用真实的果蝇逃逸、梳理、行走和睡眠回路来表现行为。

**关键细节：**

- **大脑窗口：** 23,210 个真实神经元胞体位置（共 139,255 个）的旋转 3D 视图，按细胞类型着色。两个黄色标记是巨纤维——逃逸指令神经元。
- **神经回路：** 一个包含 668 个神经元、约 19,000 个真实突触连接的网络，以 1 kHz 的漏电积分发放模拟运行。包括逼近检测神经元（LC4/LPLC2）、逃逸指令（DNp01/GF）、转向、行走、梳理、后退运动、翅膀神经元，以及感觉和上行伙伴。
- **逃逸是非预设的：** 光标靠近产生逼近输入；只有当巨纤维通过真实突触放电时，逃逸才会发生。快速猛冲会在约 4 毫秒内触发逃逸；缓慢靠近会被容忍。
- **身体行为映射：** 真实神经元放电率驱动起跳、行走速度、转向、梳理、后退急冲、翅膀用力和唤醒。
- **桌面生态：** 果蝇在窗口边缘行走、骑乘拖动的窗口、在窗口关闭时受惊、将点击视为振动做出反应，并具有昼夜节律、睡眠和温度效应。
- **无需权限：** 仅使用光标、窗口框架、点击、热状态和空闲时间 API。
- **控制：** 菜单栏项目可暂停、切换大脑窗口、运行逃逸测试、在显示器之间移动、添加/移除果蝇以及惊吓果蝇。
- **数据：** 附带精简的派生文件；可以从原始 FlyWire Codex 转储重新生成。
- **诚实声明：** 布线是真实的 FlyWire 数据；生理特性、神经递质符号和感觉转导是在该图基础上做的标准建模选择。
- **许可证：** 代码 MIT；数据 CC BY-NC 4.0。引用 Dorkenwald 等人和 Schlegel 等人的 FlyWire 论文。
